npcs.name: Hana · gardener
lines: Welcome to Windflower Village, little guardian.
The shadow spirits gather in the grove to the east. Follow the sign.

npcs.name: Taro · merchant
lines: My stall is open, but the grove has frightened away the travelers.
Try a quick thrust, a sweeping second strike, then a lunging finish.

npcs.name: Elder Sora
lines: Our shrine watches over this valley.
Restore the five spirits in the eastern grove, then return to wander in peace.

npcs.name: Yui · traveler
lines: Hold Shift to run. K dodges. The village is safe; the grove is not.

npcs.name: Akari · shrine musician
lines: The westbank bridges lead home. Rest there after each trial.
Your spirit keeps every earned coin, even after defeat.

npcs.name: Mio · lantern keeper
lines: The Hollow Bell awakens beyond three waves.
Jump its ground shock, dodge its charge, and watch for ink bolts.

npcs.name: Ren · pilgrim
lines: A guardian’s strength is remembered in ink.
Your shoulder and ankle fur will blossom with permanent power.
